summary: Materialises a durable content graph into the `content_edges` Postgres table by projecting reference-field edges (core) and plugin-contributed edges on every document save, publish, unpublish, or delete. Debounced Oban workers drive three ops — full-scope rebuild, per-doc upsert, and per-doc delete — keeping the graph consistent with the published corpus.

intentions.title: Maintain a queryable content graph as a first-class durable artefact
intentions.evidence: projector.ex: atomic DELETE+bulk-add per scope into `content_edges`; lifecycle.ex routes all four after_* events; worker queues named :edge_projector with max_attempts 5

intentions.title: Fresh-install invariant — graph works with all plugins off
intentions.evidence: projector.ex moduledoc: core `Content.extract_edges/2` is the floor; `Registry.collect_edge_extractors/1` with plugins [] contributes nothing; lifecycle.ex is wired directly from `Content.fire_after/3`, not through plugin hooks

intentions.title: Plugin highway for edge extraction — plugins extend without owning
intentions.evidence: projector.ex `edges_for_doc/2`: folds plugin `resolve_extract_edges/2` on top of core baseline; Tasks projects blocks/discovered-from/parent, Bulldocs projects paper references

intentions.title: Harden multi-tenant isolation on graph writes (fail-closed tenancy)
intentions.evidence: projector_worker.ex: nil-workspace rebuild cancelled in multi-tenant mode (`{:cancel, :nil_workspace_multi_tenant}`); `require_workspace: true` forwarded to all three op paths; projector.ex `doc_pk/2` uses `Scope.scope_to_workspace/3` strict resolution to prevent cross-tenant PK collision

intentions.title: Debounce burst writes to amortise full-scope rebuilds
intentions.evidence: projector_worker.ex: `@debounce_seconds 5`, unique on `(op, scope, _id)` across available/scheduled/executing so a burst of saves to one scope collapses into a single rebuild job

intentions.title: Spike-gate incremental upsert path until proven safe
intentions.evidence: settings.ex: `incremental_project` defaults false; lifecycle.ex comment 'UNPROVEN — a mis-diff strands stale edges in a durable Postgres table (no blue/green to discard)'; worker `run_upsert` still falls back to rebuild on missing type
